Information about OGC is available at https://ogc.house.gov. Application deadline, March 7, 2023.

Knowledge of the EEOC, OFCCP and federal statutes and policies and how they impact civil rights in employment and health care is preferred. Applicants should have a law degree and experience working with an organization, Congress, or government agency addressing civil rights. Duties will include supporting the development of legislation, providing technical assistance to the Committee and Member offices, researching pertinent issues, preparing written materials and legislative analyses, and supporting the execution of committee proceedings and events related to civil rights. Salary commensurate with experience.
